clue.text: To be concise, showing a deficit

explanation.surface: Advice on brevity that also mentions running at a loss.
explanation.definitionFit: Being brief in speech is being curt, and an account that falls below the needed amount is lacking.

clue.text: Anti-dog, you agree

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: Someone who dislikes dogs is told they are in agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: To concur is a formal synonym for being of the same opinion.

clue.text: Frittered away on a girl? Shut up!

parts.note: miss is a young unmarried woman
pent means confined, as in pent-up

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry at money wasted on a girlfriend.
explanation.definitionFit: Money that is squandered or wasted is said to be badly spent.

clue.text: Preventing from throwing the pine barrel out

indicators.note: barrel out means the barrel word sits on the outside of the other letters

parts.note: a keg is a small barrel

indicators.note: throwing the letters about means they are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone stops another from hurling a pine cask away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Preventing from' is the idiom keeping from; 'the' is a link, and the pine is tossed about inside a cask.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping someone from doing something means stopping or hindering them.

clue.text: To move home would have a disturbing effect

definitions.meaning: stop being settled in one place, read cryptically

explanation.surface: Relocating house would upset everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as un-settle it means to stop being settled in a home; as one word it means to upset or disturb.

clue.text: What the baggy pants are made of?

definitions.text: What the baggy pants are made of?

parts.words: What the baggy pants are made of?
parts.note: loose trousers look as though made from a bag, the coarse fabric of penitents

explanation.surface: A question about the fabric of loose trousers.
explanation.definitionFit: Coarse hessian cloth used for sacks and worn as a sign of mourning or penance.

clue.text: He wonders if he or I will get through. The rest retreated

indicators.note: getting through something means passing inside it, so these words go within the others
something that retreats goes backwards, so the word rest is read in reverse

explanation.surface: Someone wondering which of two people will pass while everyone else backs away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The rest retreated' reads as a separate sentence, but only 'rest' is turned round; 'The' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who speculates and forms hypotheses is a thinker who wonders about things.

clue.text: Tied up-not a penny is available

indicators.note: letters tied up in knots are twisted out of their order

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for a penny in British money

explanation.surface: Money is tied up, so not a penny can be had.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tied up' jumbles NOTA into ONTA; the surface wants 'Tied up' to mean money locked away, the opposite of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on tap is ready to hand, like beer drawn straight from the barrel.

clue.text: Further on, a punt

parts.note: in British slang a punt is a wager

explanation.surface: Encouragement to go on and place a wager.
explanation.definitionFit: To abet is to help or encourage, as one furthers a cause.

clue.text: Presents in glowing terms as a really good drink

parts.note: crack as an adjective means first-rate, as in a crack shot
to sup is to drink in sips

explanation.surface: Praise for a fine beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: If something is praised highly it is talked up, puffed or hyped as excellent.

clue.text: Holidays you'll get if you're lucky

definitions.meaning: fortunate chances, as in a lucky ...

explanation.surface: Time off from work comes to the fortunate.
explanation.definitionFit: Short holidays are vacations away from work, and strokes of luck are lucky chances.

clue.text: Desire and try to make

definitions.meaning: press or encourage someone to do something

explanation.surface: A wish combined with an attempt to persuade.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong want or impulse is a craving, and pressing someone to act is encouraging them.

clue.text: By no means gracing only some with one's presence

definitions.text: gracing only some with one's presence
definitions.meaning: attending some but missing the whole company, read literally

explanation.surface: A guest who refuses to appear everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in no way; read literally it describes someone absent from part of a gathering.

clue.text: Out of one's element abroad?

explanation.surface: Feeling uncomfortable while travelling overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Being ill at ease is feeling strange in a setting, and someone away overseas is literally absent from their residence.

clue.text: With the fights, search for a way to make a comeback

parts.note: to comb is to search thoroughly

indicators.note: coming back means returning, so the street abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A fighter looks for a way to return to the ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to make a comeback' turns ST into TS; 'With the' and 'for' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Combats are battles or contests between opponents.

clue.text: Having a little shut-eye

parts.note: not a nap but the eyelids closing for an instant, again and again

explanation.surface: Someone taking a short nap.
explanation.definitionFit: Repeatedly closing and opening the eyes in quick flickers.

clue.text: Menaces again and that's about it

indicators.note: about means around, so the word for again is placed inside

parts.note: taken as written, with the s of is
RE is a prefix meaning again

explanation.surface: Someone threatens a second time and declares the matter closed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' counts its S as a letter here, since it stands for 'that is'; 'and' and 'it' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Threats are warnings of harm, the things a bully uses to intimidate.

clue.text: But it is tender

parts.note: tender here is legal tender, money, despite the stiff adjective that contradicts softness

explanation.surface: A protest that something is soft after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Coins and notes paid on the spot form money accepted as legal tender.

clue.text: Was taken away in an emotional state again

parts.note: RE is a prefix meaning again
moved means stirred or touched by feeling

explanation.surface: Someone carried off while overcome with emotion once more.
explanation.definitionFit: Something removed has been taken off or carried elsewhere.

clue.text: The/teasing is awful in the days that follow

parts.note: something awful is bad
age means a period, as in in the days of

explanation.surface: Teasing is cruel when it lingers in later times.
explanation.walkthrough: The scan shows a stray stroke before 'teasing'; 'The', 'is' and 'that follow' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Badinage is light-hearted banter or playful mockery.

clue.text: Part of the former capital of India

definitions.text: Part of the former capital of India

parts.words: Part of the former capital of India
parts.note: capital means money, not a city: a fraction of the old rupee

explanation.surface: A district of Calcutta or old Delhi.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' suggests Calcutta, but it means money: the coin was a sixteenth of a rupee.
explanation.definitionFit: A former Indian coin worth one sixteenth of a rupee.

clue.text: Go off to get a table

parts.note: to rot is to decay or go bad

explanation.surface: Food spoils so someone gets a table.
explanation.definitionFit: A rota is a list or table of duties in turn.

clue.text: Information from someone with part of a finger missing?

definitions.text: someone with part of a finger missing?
definitions.meaning: the end of a finger removed, read literally

explanation.surface: Gossip from a person who has lost a fingertip.
explanation.definitionFit: A warning or hint is a piece of private information; read literally, a fingertip has come off.

clue.text: Courage is a vital necessity

definitions.meaning: the organ without which one cannot live

explanation.surface: Bravery is essential.
explanation.definitionFit: Bravery is spirit, and the organ pumping blood is essential to life.

clue.text: Very disturbed has to find out-to know

indicators.note: out signals that the letters are put out of place and rearranged

parts.note: ken is a Scottish and old word meaning to know

explanation.surface: Someone is upset to discover what they now know.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' jumbles HAS into SHA; 'to find' and 'to' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone shaken is upset, rattled or deeply unsettled.

clue.text: Seized and tied up

definitions.meaning: taken over by force, as a country

explanation.surface: Something captured and bound.
explanation.definitionFit: A territory captured is taken over, and a busy person is engaged elsewhere.

clue.text: Change to "eleven fifty-nine and fifty-nine seconds"

definitions.meaning: the final moment of the morning, before noon

explanation.surface: An instruction to alter a time to one second before noon.
explanation.definitionFit: To amend is to alter; read as a.m. end it names the last second before midday.

clue.text: It means the engagement is temporarily off

definitions.text: It means the engagement is temporarily off

parts.words: It means the engagement is temporarily off
parts.note: an engagement is a battle, not a betrothal: a halt in fighting

explanation.surface: A wedding is postponed for now.
explanation.definitionFit: A truce is a pause in hostilities agreed by both sides.
